scene_design.subject: A clearly adult East Asian knight attending to a meaningful detail of her work.
scene_design.setting: A sheltered castle gate at the end of a cool evening patrol.
scene_design.action: She holds the gate latch while checking that the portcullis chain has settled securely.
scene_design.cue1: A lowered portcullis and guard banner frame the stone entry.
scene_design.cue2: A shield bearing the castle crest rests beside the gatepost.
scene_design.wardrobe: Etched steel cuirass with a fitted waist, articulated pauldrons, leather straps and asymmetric segmented tassets; a narrow side opening above a dark fitted undersuit.
scene_design.composition: Waist-up candid; face, role clothing and task carry the story.
scene_design.expression: She watches her task with focused eyes and a faint, tired trace of satisfaction.
scene_design.action_physics: Her right elbow bends as her gloved fingers hold the control; her left hand rests at her waist.
